Source for 'Probe file input'. A path relative to MEDIA_DIR, an absolute path, or file:///abs. Anything outside MEDIA_DIR is rejected with 400.
Source for 'Probe UDP input'. Host and port are both required. Point it at a real feed before sending, or expect 422.

Source for 'Probe SRT caller'. latency is MILLISECONDS here, matching transport.srt.latency in the engine config; the route converts it to the microseconds libsrt wants. Use mode=listener to bind and wait instead.
Source for 'Probe HLS input'. http/https only; credentials in the userinfo are rejected. The API's own /hls mount is a convenient real source.
